_printAreasNote: Every product's printFiles uses keys "Front", "Back", "left-sleeve" and "right-sleeve". "Front"/"Back" are the literal dashboard labels and passed a real order untouched. The dashboard calls the other two "Left sleeve"/"Right sleeve", but the Order API rejects any "type" value containing a space ("Only letters, digits, underscore, period, and hyphen are allowed") — so those two are a hyphenated guess at Gelato's underlying slug, not a confirmed name. If a test order's back/front print correctly but the sleeves come back blank, wrong-sided, or rejected again, that guess needs correcting — check whether Gelato's product API (GET the product) exposes the real machine key for those two positions instead of guessing again by trial and error.
